beats.text: In Trinidad and Tobago, the entire workforce is part-time. In Poland, it is 0.4%.
This counts everyone working less than 35 actual weekly hours.
Germany has 44.5%, which is 15 times the 3.0% in the UAE.
Poland is the world's lowest at 0.4%. Mongolia has 4.8% and Russia has 7.1%.
